name: Zephyr

features.name: Iron Defense
features.text: Your Defense is DEX+STR as long as you are unarmored.

source.note: The proficiency effect (unarmedCrit) is not part of Iron Defense’s text: the stat block lists “Weapons: Melee, Unarmed Strikes”, and it is attached to the first level-1 feature so the engine sees it.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: Gain 1 Momentum for every space you move. You may expend 1 Momentum to add 1 damage to any melee attack. All Momentum is lost if you take damage, or at the end of combat.
features.manualNote: Add 1 Momentum for every space you move. When you spend Momentum on a melee attack, add that much damage to the attack by hand.

source.note: The book gives no maximum for Momentum; max "99" is a placeholder meaning “no limit”. FAQ (PDF 8, printed 14): movement while Riding and forced movement also count toward Momentum.

features.name: Burst of Speed
features.text:
When you roll Initiative, gain DEX Bursts of Speed for this encounter. You may spend 1 Burst of Speed to use one of the following maneuvers:
• Slipstream. Whenever you Defend: Apply your Defense to every attack against you this round OR you may first move 1 space.
• Galeforce Strike. Roll 1d12 for an unarmed attack instead of 1d4.
• Windstep. Move for free, ignoring enemy spaces this turn.

action.name: Slipstream
action.text: Slipstream. Whenever you Defend: Apply your Defense to every attack against you this round OR you may first move 1 space.

action.name: Galeforce Strike
action.text: Galeforce Strike. Roll 1d12 for an unarmed attack instead of 1d4.

action.name: Windstep
action.text: Windstep. Move for free, ignoring enemy spaces this turn.

features.manualNote: Slipstream: when you Defend, apply your Defense to every attack against you this round, or move 1 space first. Windstep: move, ignoring enemy spaces this turn.

source.note: “For this encounter” is modelled as gaining all Bursts on Initiative and losing them at combat end. Galeforce Strike is modelled as an Unarmed Strike (Core Rules 1d4+STR) with the die replaced by var.galeforce. FAQ (PDF 8, printed 14): Slipstream’s 1-space move makes the attack miss if it takes you out of Reach/Range or into Full Cover; Cover gives disadvantage as normal.

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Choose a Zephyr subclass.

features.name: Piercing Blows
features.text: You may spend Momentum before you make an Unarmed Strike to gain advantage for every 2 spent.
features.manualNote: Before an Unarmed Strike, spend Momentum by hand; roll with 1 advantage for every 2 Momentum spent.

features.name: Reactive Force
features.text: Whenever you gain a Wound, gain a Burst of Speed.

effects.text: Reactive Force: gain a Burst of Speed.

features.manualNote: When you gain a Wound, add 1 Burst of Speed by hand.

features.name: Martial Master
features.text: Choose a Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Supernatural Speed
features.text: While unarmored, you may use Momentum to treat a Primary Die rolled against you as if it rolled 1 lower for every 2 Momentum spent.
features.manualNote: When a Primary Die is rolled against you while unarmored, spend Momentum by hand; it counts as 1 lower for every 2 Momentum spent.

features.name: Iron Defense (2)
features.text: Your Defense is (3×STR)+DEX as long as you are unarmored.

source.note: Iron Defense (1) stays active; the engine uses the higher of the two “set” values.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Martial Master (2)
features.text: Choose a 2nd Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Swift Fists
features.text: If you have no actions and haven’t attacked this turn, your Galeforce Strike costs 0 actions.
features.manualNote: If you have no actions left and haven’t attacked this turn, use Galeforce Strike without spending an action.

features.name: Infuse Strength
features.text: Whenever you make an Unarmed Strike, you may expend 1 or more Hit Dice and add them to the strike’s total. Instead of dealing damage, heal the target for that amount (you can use Momentum or other abilities as normal).
features.manualNote: Spend Hit Dice by hand, roll them and add them to the Unarmed Strike’s total; heal the target for the total instead of dealing damage.

source.note: FAQ (PDF 8, printed 14): Infuse Strength can be used as an Opportunity Attack or Coordinated Strike.

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Gain your Zephyr subclass feature.

features.name: Galeforce Strike (2)
features.text: Your Galeforce Strike increases to 1d20.

features.name: Martial Master (3)
features.text: Choose a 3rd Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Swift Feet
features.text: Gain +2 to your Speed and Initiative as long as you are unarmored.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Martial Master (4)
features.text: Choose a 4th Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Unyielding Resolve
features.text: Ignore the first Wound you would suffer each encounter (when-Wounded abilities, such as Reactive Force, still trigger).

effects.text: Unyielding Resolve: ignore the first Wound you would suffer this encounter (when-Wounded abilities still trigger).

features.manualNote: The first time you would suffer a Wound each encounter, don’t mark it (when-Wounded abilities still trigger).

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Gain your Zephyr subclass feature.

features.name: Kinetic Marvel
features.text: Double the damage granted by Momentum.
features.manualNote: Each Momentum spent on a melee attack adds 2 damage instead of 1.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Unyielding Resolve (2)
features.text: Ignore the first 2 Wounds you would suffer each encounter.

effects.text: Unyielding Resolve (2): ignore the first 2 Wounds you would suffer this encounter.

features.manualNote: Don’t mark the first 2 Wounds you would suffer each encounter.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Blur
features.text: Gain 10 Momentum when you roll Initiative.
features.manualNote: When you roll Initiative, add 10 Momentum by hand.

features.name: Subclass
features.text: Gain your Zephyr subclass feature.

features.name: Swift Feet (2)
features.text: Gain another +2 to your Speed and Initiative as long as you are unarmored.

features.name: Key Stat Increase
features.text: +1 DEX or STR.

features.name: Unyielding Resolve (3)
features.text: Ignore the first 3 Wounds you would suffer each encounter. You have advantage on STR saves while Dying.

effects.text: Unyielding Resolve (3): ignore the first 3 Wounds you would suffer this encounter.

option.label: Unyielding Resolve: advantage on STR saves while Dying

features.manualNote: Don’t mark the first 3 Wounds you would suffer each encounter.

features.name: Secondary Stat Increase
features.text: +1 INT or WIL.

features.name: Martial Master (5)
features.text: Choose a 5th Martial Arts Ability.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Choose an Epic Boon (see pg. 75 of the GM’s Guide).

features.name: Windborne
features.text: +1 to any 2 of your stats. +1 additional Burst of Speed when you roll Initiative. Permanently gain 1 action (while Dying, you have a max of 2 actions).
features.manualNote: Take 1 extra action every turn (while Dying, you have a max of 2 actions).

source.note: The extra Burst of Speed raises the Burst of Speed maximum (DEX+var.burstBonus) so it is gained on Initiative. The extra action has no sheet field yet.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Airshift
zephyr.martial-arts.text: If you move through the space of a willing creature while using Windstep, they can move with you and choose any space adjacent to or along your path of movement to end in.
zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: Move the willing creature by hand to a space adjacent to or along your Windstep path.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Bodily Discipline
zephyr.martial-arts.text: End any single condition on yourself (ending Dying grants 1 HP, ending Dazed grants 1 action, etc.).

action.name: Bodily Discipline
action.text: End any single condition on yourself (ending Dying grants 1 HP, ending Dazed grants 1 action, etc.).

zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: Remove the condition by hand (and gain 1 HP if it was Dying, 1 action if it was Dazed, etc.).

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Cyclonic Pull
zephyr.martial-arts.text: Whenever you avoid all of the damage of a melee attack (whether it misses or you Defend), you may swap places with the attacker.
zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: Swap your token with the attacker’s when you avoid all of a melee attack’s damage.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Enduring Soul
zephyr.martial-arts.text: Whenever you roll Initiative, gain Hit Dice equal to the actions you get on your first turn (they expire at the end of combat if unused).

effects.text: Enduring Soul: gain Hit Dice equal to the actions you get on your first turn (they expire at the end of combat if unused).

zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: Add the Hit Dice by hand when you roll Initiative and remove unused ones at the end of combat.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: I Jump on His Back!
zephyr.martial-arts.text: You can Ride creatures your size. While Riding, gain advantage vs your Ride, ANY damage you avoid is dealt to them. If you move into the space of a creature your size or larger with Windstep or Skystrider, gain Riding for free.

option.label: I Jump on His Back!: advantage vs your Ride

when.situation: Attacking the creature you are Riding

zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: While Riding, any damage you avoid is dealt to your Ride (apply by hand).

source.note: Advantage “vs your Ride” is modelled as a toggle on attacks against it; it may also apply to other rolls against your Ride.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Kinetic Barrage
zephyr.martial-arts.text: (1/turn) Whenever you make a melee attack and spend no Momentum, gain DEX Momentum.
zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: Once per turn, after a melee attack where you spent no Momentum, add DEX Momentum by hand.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Mighty Soul
zephyr.martial-arts.text: You cannot be moved against your will. Whenever you would fail a roll, you may gain a Wound in order to add STR to the result you rolled. Repeat this any number of times.
zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: When you would fail a roll, mark a Wound and add STR to the result; repeat as often as you like.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Quickstrike
zephyr.martial-arts.text: Whenever you Interpose, you may first make an Unarmed Strike against the enemy for free.
zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: When you Interpose, roll a free Unarmed Strike against the enemy first.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Twisting Deflection
zephyr.martial-arts.text: Reaction (when you avoid all of the damage of a melee attack—whether it misses or you Defend): Force another logical target within Reach to be hit instead.

action.name: Twisting Deflection
action.text: Reaction (when you avoid all of the damage of a melee attack—whether it misses or you Defend): Force another logical target within Reach to be hit instead.

zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: The GM applies the attack to the new target.

source.note: The image shows a dash after “attack” at a line break; pdftotext gives an em dash (—), used here.

zephyr.martial-arts.name: Skystrider
zephyr.martial-arts.text: You cannot be Grappled or Restrained while conscious. While moving, you may travel across ANY terrain ignoring all ill effects (e.g., Prone, enemies, ceilings, treetops, lava, spikes, clouds).
zephyr.martial-arts.manualNote: Ignore Grappled/Restrained while conscious and terrain effects while moving.

retrainText: Focus. Whenever you spend time meditating alone in a windy place during a Safe Rest, you may choose different Zephyr options available to you.

source.note: Stat block and level table on PDF 3 (levels 1–4 printed 4, levels 5–20 printed 5). Secondary stats INT, WIL taken from the “Secondary Stat Increase. +1 INT or WIL.” lines. Martial Arts Abilities on PDF 4 (printed 6–7); retrainText (Focus) printed on both PDF 3 (printed 4) and PDF 4 (printed 7). Starting gear “Traveling Robes & Sandals” has no matching item in core armor/gear data, so only the Staff is in startingGear.
